About.metaDescription: Arabya is a free word-by-word Quran study platform: mushaf, iʿrāb, roots, tafsirs, translations, and Studio — with attributed sources.
About.kicker: An Arabic platform for Quran study
About.title: About Arabya
About.lead: Arabya is a platform for studying the Quranic text word by word: grammar, morphology, lexicon, semantics, translation, and tafsir — with clear attribution for every data layer. Published at www.arabya.org.
About.freeNote: Everything on Arabya is free for everyone — open access to the mushaf, study tools, and Studio.

pillars.title: What we offer
pillars.intro: We focus on understanding each word in context — not only flipping pages.
pillars.p0: Every mushaf word can be studied: iʿrāb, root, meaning, translation, and tafsir when sources are available.
pillars.p1: Every data layer is shown with its source — we do not mix opinions without labeling them.
pillars.p2: An Arabic (RTL) interface from the index to the mushaf to daily study tools.
pillars.p3: Reading, study, and Studio creation are available without fees.

features.title: What you find today
features.r0: <indexLink>Surah index</indexLink> with search in ayah text and roots, favorites, and last-read tracking.
features.r1: <mushafLink>Madinah mushaf</mushafLink> (pages 1–604) with word-by-word display, font scaling, sharing, and light/dark mode.
features.r2: <juzLink>Thirty juz index</juzLink> and surah reading with study and iʿrāb links.
features.r3: Ayah and word recitation with reciter choice and ayah repeat where available.
features.s0: Word study dock: iʿrāb · lexicon, morphology & root · translation & semantics · tafsir.
features.s2: <studyLink>Quick study</studyLink> and a <rootsLink>roots index</rootsLink> with every occurrence in the Quran.
features.t0: <asmaLink>The Beautiful Names</asmaLink>, prayer times and qibla, and daily reading habit on the home page.
features.t1: <studioLink>Arabya Studio</studioLink> to create ayah images and videos with backgrounds and export.
features.t2: <booksLink>Iʿrāb books</booksLink> and <resourcesLink>resources</resourcesLink> — updated when licensed sources are available.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.intro: We rely on open or licensed sources with attribution:
sources.qurancom: <qLink>Quran.com</qLink> — QPC Hafṣ text, ayah translations, word-by-word glosses, and tafsirs used in the UI.
sources.corpus: <cLink>Quranic Arabic Corpus</cLink> — organized morphology, iʿrāb, and roots (GPL with attribution).
sources.lemma: Local Arabic lemma senses for Arabya (lemma-sense-ar) for short study glosses.
sources.asmaData: Beautiful Names content and attributed meanings in project data.
sources.gitFirst: Static Quran content is managed Git-first so it stays transparent and traceable.

next.title: What we are working on
next.intro: We deepen Quran word layers in the UI before expanding other hubs.
next.n0: Richer semantics and rhetoric layers when attributed sources are available.
next.n1: Classic iʿrāb books and dictionaries after written licensing from rights holders.
next.n2: Later hubs (such as hadith and heritage) after the Quran word foundation is solid in the UI.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions or suggestions: the <ghOrgLink>Arabya-ai</ghOrgLink> organization on GitHub. See also our <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink>.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Arabya protects your privacy: browse without an account, optional sync, and what stays local or in the cloud.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: Arabya respects your privacy. You can read the mushaf and study without an account. Google sign-in is optional to sync your data across devices. We do not sell personal data. Everything on Arabya is free for everyone.

summary.title: Quick summary
summary.s0: No sign-in is required to read, study, or use Studio.
summary.s1: Without an account: favorites, notes, and reading habit stay on your device only.
summary.s2: With a Google account: that data may sync to cloud storage tied to your email.
summary.s3: Everything on Arabya is free for everyone.
summary.s4: Aggregated usage stats may be recorded via hosting tools (such as Vercel Analytics).

accounts.title: Optional account (Google)
accounts.p0: When you sign in we typically receive name, email, and profile photo to show your account and manage the session — not for advertising.
accounts.p1: The session uses technical cookies (Auth.js). You can sign out anytime from <accountLink>My account</accountLink>.

sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.p0: When sync is enabled for a signed-in account, a copy is stored of:
sync.i0: Favorites and last mushaf page / reading progress.
sync.p1: Purpose: restore your data on another device after sign-in. Visitors without an account do not upload personal data.

local.title: What stays on your device
local.p0: A local copy for speed, plus UI settings (appearance, font size, gloss language, translation, reciter…). You can clear site data from browser settings.

server.title: Hosting & providers
server.site: Site: Vercel — technical logs may include IP addresses or user-agent strings for security and diagnostics.
server.sync: Sync: Cloudflare (Workers / D1) when using an account.
server.login: Sign-in: via Google — see Google privacy policy as well.
server.media: Media: recitation files may load from third-party servers when played.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p0: We use cookies required for the session after sign-in, plus local storage for preferences. We do not use third-party ad trackers across sites.

rights.title: Your rights & choices
rights.r0: Browse and study without an account.
rights.r1: Sign out and clear local storage from the browser.
rights.r2: Request inquiry or deletion of account data via <ghOrgLink>Arabya-ai</ghOrgLink> on GitHub.

changes.title: Policy changes
changes.p0: We update this page when major features change. The Last updated date above reflects the current version. For more: <aboutLink>About Arabya</aboutLink>.
